description: Raw-input -> cleaned structure -> chain-health report -> pocket detection, run end to end through the production code path (app.tools.structure_prep) on real PDB entries with predeclared assertions.

predeclared_assertions.cleanup_keeps_protein: cleaned output is non-empty and contains ATOM records
predeclared_assertions.cleanup_removes_hetatm_waters: cleaned output contains no HETATM or water lines
predeclared_assertions.pocket_detection_runs_complete: fpocket returns status 'complete' for every entry
predeclared_assertions.pocket_expected_found: entries flagged expect_pocket=true report >=1 pocket; others only require complete status

limitations: Requires outbound network (RCSB fetch) and the fpocket binary installed in the runtime image.
Pocket 'found' means fpocket reported at least one pocket for the cleaned structure; the number of pockets is not asserted as a distribution (no overfitting to fpocket internals).
PyMOL cleanup uses pymol2 wheel when importable, else the Biopython stripping fallback; the fallback path is logged loudly and recorded per entry.
Live run blocked while Docker daemon is down locally (fpocket binary unavailable); the runner records requires_external and never fabricates a pass.
